proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10816 retra explicitly gives regional ret/retā “sand”. Its addendum qualifies the weak evidence for the reconstructed tr cluster. Survey final aspiration is retained as a local phonetic uncertainty without claiming a different sand root. Reviewed comparator: Rana ɾet “sand” (f_k23ceeauz4pbk). Any uncertain transfer between Indo-Aryan languages remains open under the user’s preference; source phonetic details are preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4147 distinguishes *gāvā (section 2), with Kalasha gak, Savi gāu and northern gāv, from gāvī (section 3), with Hindi gāī and Bshk. gay. Northern bare gā/gāu cannot simply be copied to gāvī without paradigm evidence. Reviewed comparator: Bshk gāī “cow” (f_a3okj55rinceg). Any uncertain transfer between Indo-Aryan languages remains open under the user’s preference; source phonetic details are preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 8209 pibati gives the widespread pi-/piy- “drink” verb. Ordinary piyo/piye inflections fit; pī-lo can include the take light verb, and pī-ryo a progressive construction, so these need full-predicate analysis. Reviewed comparator: H piyo “drink!” (f_xpcv75shnq3ye). Any uncertain transfer between Indo-Aryan languages remains open under the user’s preference; source phonetic details are preserved.
